acceptable_resolution_paths.description: Use an eligible Vercel plan/capability and activate alert rules corresponding to the existing PartGraph SLO catalog.
Connect an alert-capable backend such as Datadog, Sentry, Checkly, New Relic, Honeycomb, or equivalent and forward/query the required PartGraph/Vercel signals.

activation_proof_required: rule ID for every non-manual PG-OBS alert
safe test alert or equivalent rule-validation proof for each signal class
engineering_status: Application telemetry, SLO definitions, runbooks, and signal wiring are complete. No decision-free repository change can make alert delivery active until a backend/plan is selected and connected.
